chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Marwan, raising it (to the Imam), said:
Amir Al-Momineen (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who says, when he sneezes, “The Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds,” upon every state, will not find pain of the two ears and the teeth.'

key_terms.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ: The Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended dhikr to recite when sneezing according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Al-Kafi, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) prescribes the specific recitation of 'Al-hamdu lillahi Rabb al-'alamin' upon sneezing as a means to ward off ailments of the ears and teeth. This hadith highlights the Shia tradition of linking specific Quranic verses to physical healing, emphasizing the spiritual potency of praising Allah as the Lord of all worlds during moments of bodily release.
